long_biography.plain_text:
Within S.S. Lootah Group, chairman Yahya Bin Saeed Al Lootah combines group authority with general-management responsibility for four operating companies. He also serves as non-executive vice-chairman of Dubai Islamic Bank.

Engineering gave Lootah practical preparation for those responsibilities. He worked as an assistant to site engineers at 15, then studied civil architectural engineering and completed a master's in engineering. Appointed vice-chairman and chief executive in 1997, he became closely involved in group strategy, new business concepts and joint ventures. He now chairs Saeed Ahmed Lootah & Sons Group as well as S.S. Lootah Group.

uncertainties.detail: Strong sources establish a father-founded family enterprise, Lootah's second-generation leadership and material operating expansion. They do not disclose the legal transfer mechanism or his current personal equity percentage. Inherited and expanded therefore describes access to and development of the family platform without asserting a specific inheritance date or stake.

Official sources use Yahya Bin Saeed Al Lootah, Yahya Saeed Lootah and Yahya Saeed Ahmad Lootah. Matching engineering degrees, group tenure and operating roles establish that these forms refer to the same person. Eng. Hussain Nasser Lootah appears separately on the Dubai Medical College board, preventing conflation. The immutable display name is preserved and no middle-name proposal is made because public full-name forms vary.

Some official group pages retain the historical vice-chairman and chief executive title, while current Forbes Middle East and Campden material identify Lootah as chairman. The dossier uses current chairman for the known-for title and retains the earlier executive appointment only as durable career context.

The official group profile confirms the immutable 1973 birth year and says Lootah grew up in Dubai, but it does not establish Dubai as his birthplace. No birth day, birth month or place-of-birth proposal is made.

The official group profile directly links yahyalootah.com, and the official group website also clears the company-site threshold. Searches found no identity-secure personal LinkedIn profile. The immutable Instagram URL was preserved but not re-proposed because no current official cross-link was found during this research.

No current vessel fact was used. Private family circumstances, homes, hobbies, sensitive matters, politics, legal material, controversy, transient awards, rankings, workforce and financial figures were excluded. Nothing has been compiled or applied.
